Interface InputTrigger

All Known Implementing Classes:
KeyTrigger, MouseTrigger
public interface InputTrigger
Represents an input trigger that can match an Event.

Input triggers define what keyboard or mouse input activates an action. Implementations include:

  • KeyTrigger - Triggers on keyboard events
  • MouseTrigger - Triggers on mouse events
